big_case.notes: Emergency application by the State of Louisiana and Cameron Parish to vacate a published Fifth Circuit stay order in the billion-dollar Louisiana coastal-erosion litigation (following Chevron USA Inc. v. Plaquemines Parish, 608 U.S. 1 (2026)). The question whether a 28 U.S.C. 1447(d) appeal automatically stays a remand order under Griggs and Coinbase after transmittal to state court implicates a circuit split and state sovereign interests, but arrived in an emergency interlocutory posture with vehicle complications (Fed. R. Civ. P. 62(a) and Justice Alito's recusal) and was denied by Justice Sotomayor in chambers without referral or amicus participation one week after the Court denied cert on the same issue in City of Brunswick v. Honeywell (No. 26-289).
